$sources: TBDY 2018 Bolum 2 (hazard levels DD-1 to DD-4, local site classes ZA-ZF, Tablo 2.1 and 2.2 site coefficients, the horizontal elastic design spectrum), Bolum 3 (BKS, I, DTS, BYS, performance objectives), Bolum 4 (R and D of Tablo 4.1, Ra(T), equivalent lateral load and modal analysis, drift limits with lambda and kappa); see VERIFY.md
source: TBDY 2018 (Turkiye Bina Deprem Yonetmeligi), Bolum 2-4: the design earthquake is DD-2 (10 % in 50 years); SS and S1 of the site are read from the AFAD hazard map (site-specific: enter them under Site > Mapped spectral values; the towns give example values only); SDS = SS FS, SD1 = S1 F1 (Tablo 2.1, 2.2), TA = 0.2 SD1/SDS, TB = SD1/SDS, TL = 6 s; SaR(T) = Sae(T)/Ra(T), Ra = D + (R/I - D) T/TB below TB, R/I above (Denk. 4.1); the design earthquake categories DTS 1-4 (1a-4a for BKS 1) are SAEngine's categories D (DTS 1, 2), C (DTS 3) and B (DTS 4). Entered from knowledge of the code, every value to be checked against the printed regulation (VERIFY.md).

ZA.description: ZA: hard, sound rock (vs30 above 1500 m/s)

ZB.description: ZB: slightly weathered, medium-strength rock (vs30 760-1500 m/s)

ZC.description: ZC: very dense sand, gravel and hard clay, or weathered rock (vs30 360-760 m/s)

ZD.description: ZD: medium-dense to dense sand and gravel or very stiff clay (vs30 180-360 m/s)

ZE.description: ZE: loose sand, gravel or soft clay (vs30 below 180 m/s), or a soft clay layer over 3 m thick

ZF.description: ZF: soils needing a site-specific investigation and site response analysis (liquefiable, sensitive clays, peats, very thick soft clays)

clauses.design: TBDY 2018 2.3.3, Denk. 2.1 (SDS = SS FS, SD1 = S1 F1)
clauses.cs: TBDY 2018 4.7.1.1, Denk. 4.19 (Vt = m SaR(T) g >= 0.04 m I SDS g)

rcSmf.name: RC frames, high ductility (all seismic loads by frames)

rcCoupledWalls.name: RC coupled structural walls, high ductility

rcSpecialWallFrame.name: RC uncoupled (cantilever) structural walls, high ductility

rcDualSpecial.name: RC frames and structural walls together, high ductility

steelScbf.name: Steel concentrically braced frames, high ductility

steelOcbf.name: Steel concentrically braced frames, limited ductility

steelEbf.name: Steel eccentrically braced frames, high ductility

generatorSystems.$comment: SAEngine practice: the New Building generator's steel systems, least ductile first (TBDY 2018 Tablo 4.1 limited, then high ductility)

siteSpecificStudy.warning: Site class {classes}: {code} {clause} requires a site-specific investigation and site response analysis. Until one is made, the spectrum uses the values entered for the site (class {used}) and the design category is read for {assumed}: an assumption, not a value of the code.

allowableDriftLabel: Concrete buildings with infill walls fixed to the frame (λ δ/h ≤ 0.008 κ, κ = 1)

driftLimits.label: Steel buildings with infill walls separated from the frame or deformable connections (λ δ/h ≤ 0.016 κ, κ = 0.5)
Steel buildings with infill walls fixed to the frame (λ δ/h ≤ 0.008 κ, κ = 0.5)
Concrete buildings with infill walls separated from the frame or deformable connections (λ δ/h ≤ 0.016 κ, κ = 1)

driftServiceRatio.label: λ
driftServiceRatio.clause: TBDY 2018 4.9.1.3 (λ = Sae(DD-3) / Sae(DD-2) at the period; 1.0 here on the safe side: enter the site's ratio as a Code Value)

reentrantCorner.label: A3 re-entrant corners (projections over 20 % of the plan dimension)

diaphragmDiscontinuity.label: A2 floor discontinuity (openings over 1/3 of the floor)

inPlaneDiscontinuity.label: B3 discontinuity of the vertical elements

clauses.strength: the storey shear strength of the columns and walls (the ACI 318 form of the base pack, SAEngine practice)

clauses.records: TBDY 2018 2.5.1-2.5.2 (at least 11 records or pairs, the mean spectrum from 0.2 T to 1.5 T at least the target; the SRSS of the pairs at least 1.3 times)
clauses.nonlinearRecords: TBDY 2018 2.5.2 and Bolum 13 (DD-1 target for the collapse prevention evaluation; factor 1.5 SAEngine practice for DD-1 / DD-2: enter the site's DD-1 values)

sources.siteClasses: TBDY 2018 16.4, Tablo 16.1: the local site classes ZA-ZF by vs30 (and the SPT / undrained strength columns, not used)
sources.designSpectrum: TBDY 2018 2.3.4: Sae(T) = (0.4 + 0.6 T/TA) SDS up to TA = 0.2 TB, SDS to TB = SD1/SDS, SD1/T to TL, SD1 TL/T² beyond (TL = 6 s, the towns' tl); 4.7.1.1: Vt ≥ 0.04 m I SDS g
sources.systems: TBDY 2018 Tablo 4.1: R and D (overstrength) by system; Cd = R (δ = (R/I) Δ, 4.9.1.1); Omega0 holds D; the height limits of the limited-ductility systems (not permitted in DTS 1, 2; BYS ≥ 6 in DTS 3, 4: HN ≤ 28 m) are an SAEngine reading of the table's permitted BYS columns
sources.periodCoefficients: TBDY 2018 4.7.3.3, Denk. 4.31: Ct = 0.1 RC frames, 0.08 steel frames, 0.07 eccentrically braced steel frames, 0.05 other buildings
sources.designCategories: TBDY 2018 Tablo 3.2: DTS 4 (SDS < 0.33), 3 (0.33-0.50), 2 (0.50-0.75), 1 (≥ 0.75) (1a-4a for BKS 1): SAEngine's slots B (DTS 4), C (DTS 3) and D (DTS 1, 2)
sources.requiredDetailing: TBDY 2018 4.3.2-4.3.3: high ductility in DTS 1 and 2; limited ductility permitted in DTS 3 and 4 (SAEngine's intermediate)
sources.allowableDrift: TBDY 2018 4.9.1.3, Denk. 4.34: λ (δi)max/hi ≤ 0.008 κ (infill walls fixed to the frame) or 0.016 κ (separated or deformable), κ = 1 concrete, 0.5 steel
sources.liveShare: TBDY 2018 4.5.9.1, Tablo 4.3: n = 0.3 for residences and offices (0.6 shops, schools, halls; 0.8 storage: enter as a Code Value)
sources.minimumScale: TBDY 2018 4.8.4: the modal base shear at least γE = 0.80 × the equivalent lateral load Vt
sources.pgaFactor: TBDY 2018 2.3.4: the peak ground acceleration 0.4 SDS
sources.verticalFactor: TBDY 2018 4.4.3: the simplified vertical effect (2/3) SDS G (verticalFactor 1.6667 on 0.4 SDS)
sources.torsionExtreme: TBDY 2018 Tablo 3.6 A1: ηbi > 2.0 is not permitted (SAEngine's extreme torsion slot)
sources.lateralForce: TBDY 2018 4.7.2: Fi = (Vt - ΔFN) mi Hi / Σ mj Hj, ΔFN = 0.0075 N Vt at the top storey
sources.irregularities: TBDY 2018 Tablo 3.6 (check the thresholds); the stiffness irregularity B2 (ηki > 2.0, the drift ratio of adjacent storeys) is read as a storey stiffness below 0.5 × the storey above (SAEngine form)
sources.timeHistory: TBDY 2018 2.5: at least 11 records (pairs), the mean spectrum within 0.2 Tp to 1.5 Tp at least the target (single) and the mean SRSS spectrum at least 1.3 × the target (pairs)
